title: Pre-audit prep brain dump: Harper 1:1 + reviewer sync
content:
Purpose: quick scratchpad ahead of my 1:1 with the external reviewer (Tue AM) and the smaller reviewer sync (Wed). This is messy — notes to self + talking points + concrete asks.

Meeting logistics:
- 1:1 with external reviewer (Morgan) — Tue 2026-02-16 09:00 PT (30m) — focus: evidence mapping for access controls and incident response.
- Reviewer sync (internal): Wed 2026-02-17 11:00 PT (45m) — attendees: Liam, Avery, Zoe, Harper — align owners, hand off evidence.

Top goals for these meetings:
1) Confirm where each control's primary evidence lives and who will upload to the auditor folder.
2) Get buy-in on a small set of mitigating statements for gaps in vendor attestation.
3) Lock dates for evidence collection and dry-run with Morgan before the formal audit.

Priority control areas to address (my shorthand):
- Logical access (SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9): SSO provisioning docs, RBAC matrix, onboarding/offboarding log, privileged accounts list.
- Vendor management (SOC2 CC3 / ISO A.15): vendor inventory, recent re-assessments, contracts with security clauses, outstanding action items from VEND-933.
- Change management & deployment (SOC2 CC5 / ISO A.12): release checklist, PR references (infra PR #1192), emergency change process.
- Incident response & postmortems (SOC2 CC7): IR runbook, last 12 months incidents summary, proof of tabletop exercise.
- Key management & encryption (ISO A.10): KMS rotations, HSM integration notes, audit logs showing key usage.
- Data retention & deletion (SOC2 CC2): retention policy, deletion runbooks, sample deletion logs for 3 customers.

Quick evidence map (where to point reviewers):
- SSO provisioning + RBAC -> Confluence: /security/iam-onboarding + Okta audit export (S3 link) + HR offboarding ticket list (HR-SYNC-2025).
- Vendor inventory -> Google Drive: shared_drives/company/vendor-inventory.csv (needs final column: last-assessment-date).
- PR/Change evidence -> GitHub: infra PRs, release tags; add a short README in audit/ with mapping.
- Incident artifacts -> shared slack thread links + confluence incident log + redacted postmortems in auditor folder.

Open questions I must ask Morgan in 1:1:
- Auditor preference: do they want raw Okta CSVs or aggregated summaries? (I suspect raw but confirm)
- What level of vendor evidence is sufficient for subcontractors (2-tier)? Can we use recent SOC reports from vendors in place of full questionnaires?
- For a small gap (missing rotation proof for one KMS key in 2024), is a compensating control acceptable if we document a manual rotation and have a ticket?

Draft talking points / scripts (short):
- "We have primary evidence for X controls in Confluence/GitHub and secondary logs in S3. I will point you to a mapped index and upload missing artifacts by Friday."
- "For vendors without SOC reports we propose: (a) questionnaire completed in last 12 months; (b) scoped contract clause; (c) compensating monitoring — is that acceptable?"

Immediate TODOs (my personal action list) — rank: high/med/low, with rough ETA:
- HIGH: Build a single index file (CSV) mapping control IDs -> evidence location + owner. ETA: 2026-02-14. Owner: Harper.
- HIGH: Export Okta admin activity for last 18 months (and snapshot). Put CSV in auditor folder. ETA: 2026-02-15. Owner: Liam (ask in sync).
- MED: Populate vendor-inventory with last-assessment-date and attach contract links for top-20 vendors. ETA: 2026-02-20. Owner: Avery.
- MED: Draft compensating control language for KMS gap and share with Morgan. ETA: 2026-02-18. Owner: Harper.
- LOW: Redact and upload 3 postmortems for reviewer viewing. ETA: 2026-02-25. Owner: Zoe.

Risk notes / mental model:
- Biggest near-term risk is vendor evidence gaps; many small vendors have not completed the new questionnaire we shipped Q4. We should prioritize those with access to sensitive data or production infra.
- Another friction point: auditors like traceability (ticket -> PR -> deployment -> monitoring). We need to surface at least 2 exemplar traces per control to show we can follow the chain.

Draft dry-run agenda (for Wed internal sync):
1) 5m — quick goal alignment (Harper)
2) 10m — evidence index walkthrough (Harper)
3) 15m — owners confirm evidence availability & blockers (Liam/Avery/Zoe)
4) 10m — vendor gaps & proposed mitigation language (Avery/Harper)
5) 5m — next steps + deadlines (capture in JIRA)

Notes-to-self: typical auditor asks I've seen in prior runs:
- Show me a ticket where an offboarding happened and the last step verifying access revoke.
- Show me a rotation event on KMS with ticket/approval.
- For change management: show approvals for emergency change and retrospective.

Suggested JIRA tasks to create after sync (quick titles):
- SEC-PRIME: upload-okta-export-2026-02-15 (assign: Liam)
- SEC-PRIME: evidence-index-csv-create (assign: Harper)
- VEND-UPDATE: vendor-inventory-complete-top-20 (assign: Avery)

Draft mitigations language (for vendor gaps):
- "Where full SOC reports are unavailable, Redwood will accept a signed vendor questionnaire completed within 12 months, evidence of contractual security obligations, and compensating monitoring (access logs reviewed weekly and anomalies triaged)."

Quick checklist before 1:1 with Morgan:
- [ ] index CSV skeleton created
- [ ] example trace (ticket -> PR -> prod tag) ready to demo
- [ ] draft KMS mitigation ready
- [ ] list of top-20 vendors with data-access flags

Follow-up template email to reviewers (post-1:1):
Hi Morgan —
Thanks for the time. Per notes: I'll upload the evidence index and the Okta exports to the auditor folder by end of week. Please flag anywhere you want raw logs instead of summaries.
Best,
Harper

Misc brain dump:
- Consider a tiny README in auditor folder with quick path map and an index.csv — auditors love a single entry point.
- If Morgan wants live demos, schedule a short screencast for 2026-02-19.
- Double-check redaction policy for postmortems — keep PII out.

End of scratchpad. Will tidy into a cleaner doc to upload to the shared auditor prep folder after Wednesday sync.
